vectors.name: genesis founds the group: the founder is a member and Atoms take genesis ids
a 2-member group passes with 2 of 2 ballots, which closes it early
an early close once everyone has scored; a ballot after the close is ignored
a member who joined after the Proposal opened can't vote on it and isn't waited for
an open Proposal isn't final and leaves the Document unchanged
the deadline closes a Proposal at quorum, and its pass updates the Atom
a final fail leaves every Atom unchanged
a final lapse leaves every Atom unchanged
a voter's latest ballot replaces the earlier one in full
passes that close in the same minute apply in the relay order of their Proposals
an event with v: 2 is ignored and leaves state unchanged
an event that refers to an ignored event is ignored too
a repeated id is ignored, and the first copy keeps its seq and receipt time
events before genesis, or for another group, are ignored
only the first valid genesis founds the group
a member can't join twice, and keeps the name they joined with
a Proposal needs a member author, a known Atom and a 1-120 code point title
a ballot needs an eligible voter, known versions, and a reason for any 0
bad JSON and unknown event types are ignored
